Name: Eidee Easy Fishing
Author: EideeHi
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#3a9bdc][b]EIDEE EASY FISHING[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Customize, simplify, or skip almost every part of fishing[/i][/center]

[quote][center][size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]AI-ASSISTED DEVELOPMENT NOTICE[/b][/color][/size]
Since v1.3.0, this mod has been developed primarily with AI assistance. The author directs and reviews all changes, and the full source code is public on [url=https://github.com/eideehi/sdv-easyfishing]GitHub[/url].[/center]
[/quote]
[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]About[/b][/color][/size]
Eidee Easy Fishing lets you customize almost every part of fishing, from casting and waiting for a bite to the minigame, treasure, and the final catch.

Use only the features you want. You can make fishing slightly easier, remove specific steps, or automate most of the process. Every feature can be enabled or disabled individually, and the entire mod can be toggled during gameplay.

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]New in v1.4.0[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Fishing-bubble help[/b] — Aim eligible manual casts at fishing bubbles, optionally widen the sideways steering limit, and show a visual marker that tells you whether a cast can be assisted.[/*]
[*][b]Repeat fishing automatically[/b] — After one manual cast, advance the catch display and cast again until you stop, a safety condition is reached, or your chosen stop time arrives.[/*]
[*][b]Collect fishing rewards automatically[/b] — Move treasure and catch-menu items into your inventory when they fit, while leaving anything that does not fit for you to manage.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]What You Can Do[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Spend less time waiting[/b] — Get an immediate bite, automatically hook fish, always cast at maximum power, or keep recasting after one manual cast.[/*]
[*][b]Reach fishing bubbles[/b] — Steer a reachable manual cast onto bubbles and use an optional marker to see whether the assist can reach them.[/*]
[*][b]Make the minigame easier[/b] — Slow fish movement, improve the capture progress bar, make fish or treasure easier to catch, and reveal the hooked fish.[/*]
[*][b]Skip the minigame entirely[/b] — Catch fish automatically with a perfect catch.[/*]
[*][b]Improve your catches[/b] — Always catch maximum-quality or maximum-size fish, guarantee double catches with Wild Bait, or enable double catches with any bait.[/*]
[*][b]Control treasure[/b] — Guarantee a chest, make it easier to collect, turn every chest golden, or automatically move fishing rewards into your inventory when they fit.[/*]
[*][b]Expand the available fish[/b] — Catch fish regardless of season or location, as if using Magic Bait.[/*]
[*][b]Find rare fish more often[/b] — Apply the fish-selection effect of a Curiosity Lure.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][i]Multiplayer note: "Fish Appear Regardless of Season" and "Higher Chance for Rare Fish" are disabled in multiplayer. All other options work in multiplayer. When Auto Recast opens the stop menu, that menu freezes the clock only in single-player; the multiplayer clock keeps running.[/i][/size]

[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Configuration[/b][/color][/size]
The config file is generated after starting the game once. Its default location is:

[b][u]Stardew Valley/Mods/EideeEasyFishing/config.json[/u][/b]

[b]Using a mod manager such as Mod Organizer 2?[/b]
The config file may not appear in the Stardew Valley game directory because some mod managers use a virtual file system to load mods. In that case, look for [b]config.json[/b] inside the mod's installation folder managed by your mod manager.

Mod manager users are recommended to use [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], which lets you edit every option shown there in game without locating the config file manually. The optional [b]StopAutoRecast[/b] control is config.json-only.

In game, press [b]F5[/b] to reload the config or [b]F6[/b] to toggle the entire mod on or off. Both keys can be customized in config.json.

The easiest way to edit the settings is with the optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]:

[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eideehi/sdv-easyfishing/main/docs/images/config-menu.jpg[/img][/center]

[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]General Options[/b][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#3a9bdc][b]Core Fishing Help[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Mod Enabled[/b] — Master switch for the entire mod. Turn it off to disable every feature below, then use F6 to turn the mod back on during gameplay. (default: on)[/*]
[*][b]Bite Faster[/b] — Removes the wait for a fish to bite. For example, at the beach your bobber normally sits in the water for many seconds before a bite; with this option the bite comes right away. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Hit Automatically[/b] — Hooks the fish automatically, so you do not need to click to start the minigame. For example, leave "Skip Minigame" off to begin the minigame automatically, or turn both options on to catch the fish automatically. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Always Max Cast Power[/b] — Makes every cast use maximum power. For example, release the cast without filling the power bar and the cast still uses maximum power. (default: off)[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][color=#3a9bdc][b]Fishing Bubbles[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Cast At Fishing Bubbles[/b] — When you cast toward a fishing-bubble spot that a normal cast could genuinely reach, the mod guides your bobber onto it. Landing on bubbles gives you the game's normal bubble benefits, such as faster bites. It does not change fish size, quality, or treasure chance. Bubbles that are too far away, too far to the side, behind you, or off screen are silently ignored — nothing happens and no cast is wasted. While a cast is being guided, moving no longer nudges the bobber, and casts started by Auto Recast are never guided. For example, if a bubble appears a few tiles ahead of you within casting range, just cast toward it and the bobber lands on the bubble spot. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Widen Bubble Cast Assist[/b] — Requires "Cast At Fishing Bubbles" and does nothing on its own. Lets the assist reach bubbles farther to the left or right of the direction you are facing. It never makes a cast travel farther than it normally could. For example, a bubble well off to your side may become reachable, but a bubble beyond your casting distance stays out of reach. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Show Fishing Bubble Marker[/b] — Draws a frame on the bubble spot so you can see whether "Cast At Fishing Bubbles" would guide a cast there: green and pulsing means yes, grey and dashed means no. While you charge a cast, the frame follows your current cast power, so it can change as the bar fills; at other times it shows what a fully charged cast could reach. It works on its own, is purely visual, and never changes where a cast lands. The marker is hidden when the bubble tile cannot actually be fished. During an Auto Recast loop it keeps showing what a manual cast could reach. (default: off)[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][color=#3a9bdc][b]Automation[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Auto Recast[/b] — After you cast once manually, the mod advances the catch screen and keeps casting again at full power. It stops when you stop it, when your chosen stop time arrives, when a cast would use up the last of your stamina, or when a full-power cast from your position would not land on fishable water. Stop it any time with your menu key, any movement key, controller Start, B, or a D-pad direction, or the optional config.json-only "StopAutoRecast" key. For example, cast once at the mountain lake and let the mod keep fishing until you move, run low on stamina, or reach your chosen stop time. It never eats food to restore stamina, and recasts are always full power even without "Always Max Cast Power". Casts that cost no stamina (Efficient enchantment, Blessing of Waters) do not trigger the stamina stop. The stopping input still performs its normal game action. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Stop Auto Recast At Time[/b] — Sets an optional in-game time when Auto Recast stops and opens the game menu. For example, choose 10:00 PM and the loop ends at 10:00 PM so you will not fish past bedtime. Times from 6:00 AM to 1:50 AM can be chosen in 10-minute steps — always before the game's 2:00 AM pass-out. In config.json, use the game's time format (10:00 PM = 2200; 0 = disabled). (default: Disabled)[/*]
[*][b]Auto Collect Fishing Treasure[/b] — Moves the items from fishing treasure chests and catch screens into your inventory and closes the menu when everything fits. For example, open a treasure chest and its contents go straight into your bags without any clicking. If something does not fit, the menu stays open and is left entirely to you until you close it yourself — the mod will not take over again even after you free up space, and it never acts while you are holding an item on the cursor. While that menu is open, Auto Recast waits. Works with or without Auto Recast. (default: off)[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][color=#3a9bdc][b]Treasure, Double Catches, and Fish Selection[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Treasure Always Be Found[/b] — Guarantees a treasure chest on every catch, including catches made with "Skip Minigame". For example, enable both options to skip the minigame and still receive a chest with each catch. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Always Golden Treasure[/b] — Turns every naturally appearing or guaranteed treasure chest into a golden treasure chest. For example, turn this on by itself and every chest you happen to find is golden, while the chance of finding one stays normal. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Always Caught Double Fish[/b] — Makes Wild Bait always catch two fish. For example, fish normally with Wild Bait equipped and every successful catch brings in two fish instead of one. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Caught Double Fish On Any Bait[/b] — Gives any bait the double-catch chance. For example, combine it with "Always Caught Double Fish" to guarantee two fish with any bait. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Fish Appear Regardless of Season[/b] — Lets fish that would normally be unavailable in your current season or location bite your line, as if you were using Magic Bait — even with an empty bait slot. For example, catch a summer-only fish in winter from your usual fishing spot. This option is disabled in multiplayer. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Higher Chance for Rare Fish[/b] — Makes harder-to-find fish more likely to bite, as if using a Curiosity Lure. For example, enable it while hunting hard-to-find fish and keep your tackle slot free instead of equipping a Curiosity Lure. This option is disabled in multiplayer. (default: off)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Minigame Options[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Skip Minigame[/b] — Skips the fishing minigame and catches the fish automatically with a perfect catch. For example, hook a fish and go straight to the catch instead of playing the minigame. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Fish Easy Caught[/b] — Makes the fish icon automatically chase the fishing bar. For example, when the fish darts away in the minigame, it turns back toward your green bar instead of forcing you to chase it. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Treasure Easy Caught[/b] — Makes the treasure icon automatically chase the fishing bar. For example, when a treasure chest appears mid-minigame, its icon drifts toward your bar so you can grab it without losing the fish. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Always Reveal Fish Type[/b] — Shows which fish you are catching during the minigame without requiring a Sonar Bobber. For example, begin the minigame and see the fish type while using another tackle or no tackle. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Always Max Fish Quality[/b] — Forces every caught fish to Iridium quality, ignoring Quality Bobber count, rod tier, and perfect-catch requirements. For example, a non-perfect catch still becomes Iridium quality. (default: off)[/*]
[*][b]Always Max Fish Size[/b] — Makes every caught fish count as its largest possible size, even when your rod or your minigame performance would normally shrink it. For example, even a slow, sloppy catch still records the fish at maximum size. (default: off)[/*]
[/list]
[i]These sliders fine-tune the minigame's speed. Your bait, tackle, and the game's normal effects still apply on top of them.[/i]

[list]
[*][b]Fish Movement Speed Multiplier[/b] — Multiplies fish movement speed during the minigame; lower values make fish move more slowly. Lower it if fish dart around too quickly for you. (default: 0.5)[/*]
[*][b]Progress Bar Decrease Multiplier[/b] — Multiplies how quickly capture progress falls while the fish is outside the bar; lower values mean slower loss. Lower it to lose less progress while the fish is outside your bar. (default: 0.5)[/*]
[*][b]Progress Bar Increase Multiplier[/b] — Multiplies how quickly capture progress rises while the fish is inside the bar; higher values mean faster gain. Raise it to fill the catch bar faster while the fish is inside your bar. (default: 1.25)[/*]
[*][b]Treasure Catch Speed Multiplier[/b] — Multiplies how quickly treasure is collected; higher values make collection faster. Raise it to collect treasure chests in less time. (default: 1.5)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Controls[/b][/color][/size]
[i]These three controls are set in config.json and are not shown in GMCM.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]ReloadConfig[/b] — Loads changes you made in config.json without restarting the game. For example, tweak a multiplier in the file, press this key, and the new value applies immediately. (default: F5)[/*]
[*][b]ToggleMod[/b] — Turns the entire mod on or off during gameplay. For example, press it once to disable every feature and again to re-enable the mod. (default: F6)[/*]
[*][b]StopAutoRecast[/b] — Optional extra key that stops Auto Recast. For example, assign a key in config.json and press it during a loop; menu and movement keys still stop the loop when this remains "None". (default: None)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Stardew Valley 1.6 Support[/b][/color][/size]
Eidee Easy Fishing supports fishing mechanics introduced or changed in Stardew Valley 1.6:

[list]
[*][b]Challenge Bait[/b] — "Skip Minigame" catches the remaining Challenge Bait fish count instead of catching only one fish.[/*]
[*][b]Deluxe Bait[/b] — Its larger fishing bar is preserved when using the mod's fish-selection options.[/*]
[*][b]Sonar Bobber[/b] — The equipped Sonar Bobber works normally. "Always Reveal Fish Type" provides the same display effect without occupying or consuming a tackle slot.[/*]
[*][b]Golden Treasure Chests[/b] — Golden treasure rolls granted by Fishing Mastery are supported when "Treasure Always Be Found" adds a chest.[/*]
[*][b]Blessing of Waters[/b] — The mod's progress multipliers stack with the blessing's reduced progress-loss effect.[/*]
[*][b]Fish Frenzy[/b] — "Bite Faster" removes the bite timer, and "Cast At Fishing Bubbles" can target its bubble spot like other bubbles to receive the frenzy's guaranteed species. The mod does not change Fish Frenzy spawn locations.[/*]
[*][b]Beginner's Rod[/b] — Its normal quality and size limits are preserved unless "Always Max Fish Quality" or "Always Max Fish Size" is enabled.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing Tutorial[/b] — The special starting progress used for the first-ever fish is preserved.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Compatibility Notes[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Most players can ignore this section. It explains edge cases of the two fish-selection options and how they interact with bait and tackle.[/i]
"Fish Appear Regardless of Season" and "Higher Chance for Rare Fish" are the only options that change which fish is selected.

To provide these effects, the mod temporarily applies the behavior of Magic Bait or a Curiosity Lure while the game selects a fish. Your original bait and tackle are restored before they can be consumed. The temporary items are also removed before saving or ending the day.

When "Higher Chance for Rare Fish" is enabled and every tackle slot is occupied, the mod temporarily uses the first tackle slot. The original tackle and its durability are restored, but that tackle's minigame-start effect may not apply during that cast. For example, the Cork Bobber may not provide its larger fishing bar for that cast.

When "Fish Appear Regardless of Season" is enabled:

[list]
[*]Specific Bait targeting does not apply to that cast.[/*]
[*]The first bite uses the original bait's bite-time effect.[/*]
[*]Faster bite effects from Wild Bait, Challenge Bait, or Deluxe Bait may not apply to later missed-bite rerolls during the same cast.[/*]
[*]Enable "Bite Faster" if you want to remove the bite wait regardless of the equipped bait.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer:[/b] "Fish Appear Regardless of Season" and "Higher Chance for Rare Fish" are silently disabled during multiplayer sessions because fishing rod attachment slots are synchronized over the network. All other options work in multiplayer. When Auto Recast stops for stamina or the selected time, it opens the game menu. That menu freezes the game clock only in single-player; in multiplayer, the clock keeps running.

[line]
